sloka: धनदेन परित्यक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् ।आरुरोह स देवारिः स्वर्गं देवाधिपो यथा ।। ७.११.५० ॥
transliteration: dhanadena parityaktāṁ suvibhaktamahāpathām ।āruroha sa devāriḥ svargaṁ devādhipo yathā ।। 7.11.50 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of the gods, ascended to that city (Lanka), which had well-divided great roads and had been abandoned by Kubera, just as Indra ascends to heaven.
